events.title: Anthropic and OpenAI reported accelerating AI demand
events.canonical_summary: Anthropic and OpenAI disclosed rapid revenue growth and expanding enterprise demand, reinforcing the external AI-infrastructure demand path for Micron memory.
events.known_event_summary: 2026-08-14..2026-09-14 AI-customer demand update: Anthropic revenue exceeded $11.5 billion, OpenAI reached a $40 billion annualized run rate, and enterprise revenue exceeded consumer revenue.

facts.proposition: Anthropic's second-quarter 2026 revenue exceeded $11.5 billion, more than 14 times the prior-year level.
OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate reached approximately $40 billion.
OpenAI's enterprise business generated more revenue than its consumer segment.
